{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify rows with commas in revenue (potential thousands separators)
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Extract and inspect those rows
comma_rows = data[has_commas]
print("Rows with commas in revenue:")
print(comma_rows[['order_id', 'revenue']])

# Check if any of these are the internal test orders
internal_test_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Confirm that the comma rows are not test orders
print("Are the comma rows test orders?", comma_rows['revenue'].eq('999999.99').any())"}
